column3: A PROP DESIGN REFERENCE SHEET for 3D modellers, 3:2 landscape, in exactly the layout style of the attached sheet-mod-lights reference: the following objects in a clean grid on a dark charcoal studio backdrop, each shown in a FRONT view and a SIDE view next to each other (orthographic, no perspective), soft even studio light plus the warm amber glow of any lit parts, a thin white 1 m scale bar under each object, a small numbered English label with the stated size. Accurate believable proportions and real construction details (joinery, materials, wear), in the art direction of the attached concept images, rich and specific rather than generic. Objects: (1) Stair generator: straight, switchback, cliff, pool entry, ladder — about 1-4 m wide, any rise m; must show: 17 cm risers and 29 cm treads read at every LOD; landings; rough-cut stone or hinoki treads; stringer and rail posts on open sides; (2) Mist Steps water stair — about 13 x 30 m run, 20 m drop m; must show: Wide polished basalt steps with water sliding over every nosing; side run-off channel; lantern-post rails both sides; (3) Spiral Stair and Lava Stair helix — about r 8-12 m, 100 m total rise m; must show: Helical carved stone treads round a drum or shaft; continuous curved bronze-capped timber rail with lantern posts; landing doors per level; (4) Low basalt parapet and kerb wall — about per metre m; must show: Knee-to-waist-high wall of rough-cut basalt blocks with a flat cap; lantern posts or toro sit on it; (5) Basalt slab bridge — about 7.4 x 4 x 0.6 m m; must show: Thick basalt deck slab over a stream with low block parapets. + variant panel: railing styles bronze_handrail / curved_cap / ring (sheet-mod-arrival shows timber_lattice only)

A CHARACTER DESIGN REFERENCE SHEET for 3D modellers and riggers, 3:2 landscape, in the layout style of the attached sheet-mod-lights reference: on a dark charcoal studio backdrop, a lineup of spa guests and staff for a Japanese volcano onsen, each shown FRONT and SIDE (orthographic, neutral A-pose for the rig plus one small inset of a typical pose), a white 1 m scale bar and small English labels: (1) adult woman guest in an indigo yukata with obi and geta, hair up; (2) adult man guest in a dark yukata; (3) elderly guest with a walking stick; (4) child guest in a small yukata; (5) restaurant server in a dark samue apron with a tray; (6) bath attendant in a hinoki-brown samue with a towel; (7) ramen chef in white with a headband. Realistic adult proportions (1.55-1.80 m), stylised but not cartoonish, readable silhouettes, warm lantern rim light, consistent with the people in the attached concept art.

A BUILDING DESIGN REFERENCE SHEET for 3D modellers, 3:2 landscape, in the layout style of the attached sheet-mod-lights reference: on a dark charcoal backdrop, each building in a FRONT elevation, a SIDE elevation and one small three-quarter view, white 1 m and 5 m scale bars, small English labels with sizes, real timber joinery, how each one hangs from or sits on the basalt rock, warm lantern glow from the windows. Buildings: (1) Cliff-hung lit timber lodges (B3 cavern walls) — about 20 x 6 x 10 m m; must show: Multi-storey hinoki lodges with glowing shoji and lattice balconies hung on the black cavern wall on timber brackets and stilts, deep tiled eaves, lantern rows along the balconies; (2) Summit lodge with lava window — about 16 x 8 x 8 m m; must show: Timber lodge on the crater rim: glowing shoji ground floor, deep eaves, and a tall glass wall upstairs showing lava inside the rock. For the cliff lodge show 2 or 3 size variants (one-, two- and three-storey).
